overview.en: This steppe antelope is native to Central Asia, with populations in several countries.
overview.fr: Cette antilope des steppes est originaire d’Asie centrale et vit dans plusieurs pays.

identification.en: Its most distinctive feature is a swollen, flexible nose that projects beyond the mouth.
identification.fr: Son trait le plus distinctif est son nez renflé et souple, qui dépasse de la bouche.

habitat.en: It inhabits dry steppe and semi-desert.
habitat.fr: Il vit dans les steppes sèches et les semi-déserts.

diet.en: It eats grasses and herbs, with food varying by season.
diet.fr: Il mange des graminées et des herbes, selon les saisons.

behavior.en: It forms herds and moves seasonally to find grazing and avoid deep snow.
behavior.fr: Il vit en troupeaux et se déplace selon les saisons pour trouver des pâturages et éviter la neige profonde.

ecology.en: The unusual nose helps condition inhaled air in the species’ sharply seasonal steppe climate.
ecology.fr: Ce nez particulier contribue à conditionner l’air inspiré dans le climat très contrasté des steppes.

conservation.en: The global IUCN assessment was downlisted to Near Threatened in 2023.
conservation.fr: L’évaluation mondiale de l’UICN a été abaissée à « Quasi menacée » en 2023.

reproduction.en: Females give birth to one or two calves, often together in open areas.
reproduction.fr: Les femelles mettent bas un ou deux petits, souvent regroupées dans des espaces ouverts.

facts: WWF documents the saiga’s nose, range, habitat, diet, herding and calving.

title.en: IUCN SSC Antelope Specialist Group — 2023 report
title.fr: Groupe de spécialistes des antilopes de l’UICN — rapport 2023

facts: The report states that the global saiga reassessment was published in December 2023 and changed from Critically Endangered to Near Threatened; IUCN distinguishes the Mongolian subspecies assessment.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

uncertainties: Population sizes and status differ sharply between the western and Mongolian forms; the profile therefore omits current population totals.
review_note: Cross-checked a current German species profile and the IUCN specialist-group report for the 2023 global reassessment.
